newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES.

text.p: English and Scottish soccer fixtures for Saturday and Sunday (all 1400 GMT kickoffs unless stated):
English premier league - Aston Villa v Everton, Chelsea v Arsenal (1015 GMT), Manchester United v Derby, Newcastle v Sunderland, Nottingham Forest v Southampton, Tottenham v Wimbledon.

English division one - Barnsley v Birmingham, Bolton v Queens Park Rangers, Charlton v Manchester City, Crystal Palace v Huddersfield, Ipswich v Oldham, Oxford v Port Vale, Portsmouth v Grimsby, Sheffield United v West Bromwich, Stoke v Reading, Swindon v Southend, Wolverhampton v Norwich.

English division two - Brentford v Shrewsbury, Bristol City v Bury, Burnley v Millwall, Chesterfield v Gillingham, Peterborough v Bournemouth, Preston v Plymouth, Rotherham v Luton, Stockport v Bristol Rovers, Watford v Crewe, Wrexham v Walsall, Wycombe v Blackpool, York v Notts County.

English division three - Barnet v Hull, Cardiff v Cambridge United, Carlisle v Fulham, Chester v Wigan, Darlington v Doncaster, Exeter v Torquay, Hartlepool v Leyton Orient, Hereford v Colchester, Lincoln v Swansea, Northampton v Scarborough, Rochdale v Mansfield, Scunthorpe v Brighton.
Scottish premier division - Aberdeen v Motherwell, Hibernian v Dundee United, Kilmarnock v Hearts, Raith v Celtic, Rangers v Dunfermline.
Scottish division one - Airdrieonians v Clydebank, Dundee v Falkirk, East Fife v Partick, Greenock Morton v St Johnstone, Stirling v St Mirren.
Scottish division two - Brechin v Queen of South, Dumbarton v Hamilton, Livingston v Ayr, Stenhousemuir v Clyde, Stranraer v Berwick.
Scottish division three - Albion v Ross County, East Stirling v Cowdenbeath, Forfar v Alloa, Inverness Thistle v Montrose, Queen's Park v Arbroath.
English League Cup final - Leicester v Middlesbrough
English premier league - Liverpool v Coventry
